AnnotationChange.description: Only the fields sent change (null clears a note, a colour, a technique).
AnnotationChange.title: AnnotationChange

ApiError.description: Every error's answer (the OpenAPI schema's ApiError: api/openapi.py).
ApiError.title: ApiError

BookTextIn.description:
A batch of pages' text, in order (nginx takes 1 MB per request): the first batch
(first = 1) replaces what was sent before, the last one (last) completes it.
BookTextIn.title: BookTextIn

Created.description: An entry as the catalogue snapshot has it (the frontend adds it to its copy).
Created.title: Created

Date.description: CSL's date: {"date-parts": [[year, month?, day?]]} (one date, no range).
Date.title: Date

Name.description:
A person or an organisation: family + given (inverted in the bibliography), or
a literal name shown as is (an organisation, a single name, a Japanese name written
family name first: "Hatsumi Masaaki").
Name.title: Name

Parents.description: A section's school, category and weapon, or a technique's section (the others: none).
Parents.title: Parents

Reference.description:
The fields each type uses are the frontend's choice (ReferenceForm); the server
takes any of them for any type, checks their form, and needs a title.
Reference.title: Reference

Step.description: One step of the picker: an existing entry (`id`) or a new one (`new`).
Step.title: Step

TotpEnrollmentOut.description:
A fresh TOTP secret for an authenticator app (setup, registration, profile):
nothing is stored until a code from it is confirmed.
TotpEnrollmentOut.title: TotpEnrollmentOut

get.description: Every proposed entry: schools, categories, weapons, sections, then techniques; oldest first in each.

schema.title: Response List Proposals Api Admin Proposals Get

delete.description: Only while nothing uses it nor sits under it.

put.description: Its name (a new one renames it and everything under it, everywhere), names, parent, meanings.

post.description: Into an existing entry of the same kind: its uses and what is under it move there.
An ordinary entry from now on (its parents validated first).

get.description: Every role, named in the request's language and sorted by that name.

schema.title: Response Roles Api Admin Roles Get

get.description: Every tag as the Options page edits it, sorted by name in the request's language.

schema.title: Response List Tag Definitions Api Admin Tags Get

delete.description: Only a tag no video or segment uses.

put.description: The whole tag: a new ID renames it; values missing from `values` are deleted.

schema.title: Response List Users Api Admin Users Get

post.description: Create a user without credentials, and its invitation.

delete.description:
Delete the user (sessions and invitation too). Their comments, segments, videos and
uploads are kept, given to the generic deleted user. One transaction.

post.description:
Remove the password, TOTP, sessions and any invitation: the user can no longer log in
nor register. A reset (a new invitation) reactivates them.

get.description: The current invitation, to copy the link again.

post.description:
Issue a new invitation, then remove the password, TOTP and sessions.

One transaction: either the user has a new link AND no old credentials, or
nothing changed. The old password and authenticator can never be used again.

put.description:
Give the user another role. Their sessions stay: a session reads its user's role on
every request, so the new accesses apply at their next one. Never one's own (an admin
would lose User Management).
A region's crop (a JPEG the browser made, its own upload): published by the encoder.

get.description: Every book (queued, failed, published) with its reference and tags, newest upload first.

schema.title: Response List Books Api Books Get

post.description: Queue a finished PDF upload (and its thumbnail's) for the encoder, with its reference and tags.

get.description: True if a book (published, pending or failed) is this file: checked before uploading.

delete.description:
Drop a book that is not published yet (queued or failed): by its uploader or an admin
(user_mgmt). The encoder deletes its uploads.

get.description: One book (any status), as the list has it.

put.description: A book's reference and tags, by any book manager (the library is shared).

get.description: A published book's annotations, by page.

schema.title: Response List Annotations Api Books  Book Id  Annotations Get

put.description:
The text of the book's pages, extracted by the browser (the server has no PDF parser):
at the upload, else by the viewer once (has_text false). Any book manager.

A new first-page picture for a published book (the viewer makes one when it has none);
the encoder publishes it.

get.description:
The catalogue file of the request's language. Behind nginx: an empty answer
with X-Accel-Redirect; nginx serves the file, its .br/.gz variant, ETag and
Cache-Control (the app sends none).

post.description: The new steps of a technique's place, created as proposed entries.

get.description: Sorted by name, ignoring case and accents.

schema.title: Response List Performers Api Performers Get

post.description: A fresh TOTP secret and its QR code. Nothing is stored until /totp/confirm.
Replace the TOTP secret, once a code from the new one proves the app is set up.
A fresh TOTP secret and its QR code. Nothing is stored until /complete.
The username the invitation is for.

get.description: Every term must match (any part of a word, accents and case ignored); best first.

post.description: Create the database and the admin user. Streams one JSON line per completed step.
A fresh TOTP secret and its QR code. Nothing is stored until /complete.

get.description: Every tag, sorted by name in the request's language, with its rule.

schema.title: Response List Tags Api Tags Get

get.description: What the books say about a technique: every logged-in user (the technique's page).

schema.title: Response Technique Notes Api Techniques  Technique Id  Book Notes Get

get.description: Last modified first.

schema.title: Response Technique Comments Api Techniques  Technique Id  Comments Get

get.description: Can the server receive uploads now? The page warns before work is lost.

What the upload page may send (checked again by the pre-create hook, and the
content by ffprobe before encoding): the page refuses other files at once.
My videos waiting, being encoded or failed, and those published this week.

schema.title: Response My Uploads Api Uploads Mine Get

post.description: Queue a finished upload for encoding, with its segments and tags.

get.description: Every published video with its tags, newest upload first.

schema.title: Response List Videos Api Videos Get

get.description: True if a video (published, pending or failed) has this original or this encoded file.

delete.description: Drop a video that is not published yet. The encoder deletes its original.

post.description: Queue a failed video again (its original is still on the server).

The encoder published a video or made thumbnails: rebuild the catalogue now
(not debounced: publishing is rare, and the upload page fetches it at once).
Always 200: a rejection is said in the JSON (an error status fails the upload as a 500).

schema.title: Response Tusd Hook Internal Tusd Hook Post

get.description:
nginx auth_request for /files/…: 204 = forward to tusd; 401/403/404 = refuse.
The subrequest carries the browser's headers: a write (create, chunk, cancel) from
another origin is refused, as for the API (main.same_origin_writes).
